devdoc.custom:security: Only the Hook may call mutating functions. Use a trusted Hook.
devdoc.details: - All state-changing functions are restricted to the configured Hook via onlyHook. - Epochs are indexed by epochId. New requests are tagged with the current epochId and are settled   when the Hook calls settle(). After settlement, epochId is incremented to open a new epoch. - Fulfillment is stored in basis points (BPS) and the settlement rate is stored as assets-per-share   scaled by 10**shareDecimal. - This module does not move tokens. The Hook is responsible for redeeming shares, transferring assets,   and invoking claim() to decrement user requests accordingly.

params.epochId: The newly opened epoch id (the previous epochId - 1 was just settled).
params.rate: Assets-per-share settlement rate for the settled epoch, scaled by 10**shareDecimal.

params.shares: Amount of shares accounted as claimed.

params.receiver: Address for which the withdrawal was requested.

claim(address,uint256).details: - Reverts if attempting to claim more shares than requested. - When a receiver's outstanding shares reach zero, clears their epochId. - Asset transfer is performed by the Hook after computing claimable().

params.shares: Number of shares being marked as claimed.

claimable(address).details: - If the receiver last requested in the current open epoch, nothing is claimable yet. - Iterates from the receiver's last request epoch up to the most recently settled epoch   applying each epoch's fulfillment and rate. - Assets are computed as settledShares * rate / 10**shareDecimal.

returns.assets: Total claimable assets for the receiver.
returns.shares: Total shares that will be marked as claimed.

params._hook: Address of the Hook that controls this module.
params._shareDecimal: Decimals used to scale assets-per-share rate (matches the share token decimals).

request(address,address,address,uint256).details: - Accumulates requested shares in orders[receiver]. - Tags the order with the current epochId if it lags behind. - Increments totalWithdraw for the current epoch. - Token movements are handled by the Hook; this function updates accounting only.

params.receiver: Address that will receive assets when claimed.

settle(uint256,uint256).details: - Records fulfillment = shares / totalWithdraw (in BPS) for the current epoch. - Stores the provided settlement rate. - Reduces totalWithdraw by shares and increments epochId (opening a new epoch). - Emits EpochSettled with the newly opened epoch id.

params.shares: Total shares being settled in this epoch across all users.

devdoc.title: Batched withdrawal request/settlement module

EpochSettled(uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when an epoch is settled and a new epoch is opened.

WithdrawClaimed(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when a receiver's settled shares are claimed (accounting-only in this module).

WithdrawRequested(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when a receiver requests a withdrawal.

claim(address,uint256).notice: Account for a receiver's claim of settled shares.

claimable(address).notice: Compute claimable assets and shares for a receiver across all settled epochs.

epochId().notice: Current open epoch identifier (first epoch is 1).

request(address,address,address,uint256).notice: Queue a withdrawal request for shares in the current epoch.

settle(uint256,uint256).notice: Settle a portion of pending withdrawals for the current epoch with a given rate.

totalWithdraw().notice: Total shares requested for withdrawal across all users for the current open epoch.

userdoc.notice: Queues per-user share withdrawal requests into epochs and settles them pro-rata at an assets-per-share rate.
